Orderly fortnight desk rules for gate calls
This section sets out what applies on every shift

Companion Animal Travel Desk

Purpose: to protect animal welfare, keep the handoff orderly, and ensure every passenger receives clear, swift, and calm service.

Staff must treat each carrier as a priority item and move it only with both hands, level and secure, so that no animal is jolted or left in a draft. Keep the desk clear, verify the travel documents at once, and give plain guidance that can be followed without delay. If a passenger is anxious, answer in a steady voice and keep instructions brief. Never leave a carrier in a public path or beside active doors. If a crate shows damage, soiling, loose latches, or signs of stress in the animal, stop the handoff and alert the senior coordinator immediately. The ground team must not improvise transport routes or place a carrier with baggage that can shift. Where a traveler needs more room, a new holding position must be arranged without argument and without delay. For routine guidance on lounge handling, <<FACT F002>>. For the arrival sequence, <<FACT F019>>. These statements remain binding and must be followed exactly as issued.

Use only approved labels, keep names matched to the booking, and repeat the destination to the traveler before release. When Samuel Costa, Ethan Ali, or any other traveler presents a pet such as Loki, the desk must remain calm, respectful, and precise. Do not promise exceptions, do not speculate about transfer conditions, and do not refer passengers to other counters unless the desk has already confirmed support. If a delay threatens the connection, escalate at once and keep the passenger informed in direct language. Any irregularity, including refusal to board, must be recorded before the end of the shift.

Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor at once for any unresolved welfare concern, document mismatch, or gate dispute.
